videos.title: 05.08.26 - RIFT Training Day
videos.summary_source_text:
05.08.26 - RIFT Training Day RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

videos.summary_source_text:
Demidov’s Punch Precursor The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

Start Your Downswing the Right Way Your downswing problem might actually start before your backswing is finished. 👀

Most golfers wait too long to shift forward. Then the upper body takes over, the club gets steep, and the ball flight becomes unpredictable.

The better sequence?
Start shifting toward the target as your backswing finishes.

That early pressure shift gives your arms room to drop, helps the club shallow naturally, and sets you up for better rotation, forward shaft lean, and more consistent contact.

But knowing what to do isn’t enough you need to be able to feel when you’re doing it correctly.
That’s exactly where the B29 Blue Brick. It gives you immediate feedback on your swing path, body movement, and alignment, so you can stop repeating the same downswing mistakes and start training the correct sequence.

OpenAI has an unreleased AI model reportedly solving math problems that human mathematicians couldn't crack. At the same time, a frontier AI rulebook has been finalized behind closed doors — and new legal analysis is raising a much bigger question: what happens when an autonomous AI agent crosses a line the law wasn't designed for?

These look like three separate AI stories.

They aren't.

In this week's AI roundup, we break down the claims surrounding OpenAI's internal Astra model, its machine-verified mathematical proofs, the frontier AI framework involving major labs including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, and the growing legal problem surrounding autonomous AI agents.

We also separate what has actually been confirmed from what remains inference, reporting, or unanswered.

From OpenAI and GPT-5.6 to Anthropic's Claude, Google Gemini and Meta's frontier AI efforts, the bigger issue isn't simply which company has the most powerful AI model.

It's whether AI capability is moving faster than transparency, regulation and legal accountability can keep up.

videos.title: Could This Become a Somatic Retreat in Kyoto, Japan?
videos.summary_source_text:
Could This Become a Somatic Retreat in Kyoto, Japan? Could this quiet log house in the Kyoto countryside someday become a small somatic retreat space?

My family and I are staying at Yuka’s parents’ log house in Keihoku, surrounded by forests, mountains, a flowing river, and a much slower pace of life than central Kyoto.

While we were here, Yuka raised an unexpected possibility: perhaps this could become a place for a small English-language somatic retreat someday.

Not a luxury resort. Not a large event or a packed schedule.

I imagine something quieter and more personal—a small group gathering to explore gentle somatic movement, walk, rest, reflect, and reconnect with the body away from the usual noise and pressure.

For me, the idea also feels meaningful because I was born and raised in Japan, but I have taught mainly in English for many years. Bringing English-speaking students here could create a bridge between my background, my family, my work, and the people who have learned with me from around the world.

This is not an official retreat announcement yet. We are simply exploring whether there is genuine interest.

If the idea speaks to you, leave the words “Kyoto retreat” in the comments. You can also share what you would hope to experience in a small somatic retreat like this.

If you are tired of treating your body like a problem to solve, you can learn more about my guided course, Moving Freely in Your Body, here:
https://taroiwamoto.com/thecourse

This course is for thoughtful, self-aware adults who are ready to move beyond chasing relief, correcting their body, or piecing together random exercises — and begin learning a different relationship with their body through guided somatic movement.

If you’re newer to this work, start with my free somatic masterclass:
Move More Freely in Your Body
https://taro-iwamoto.thinkific.com/courses/masterclass

Read my book:
Your Body Is Not Broken: A Gentle Somatic Path to Moving with More Ease, Trust, and Freedom

A short Kindle book for anyone tired of trying to fix their body and wanting a gentler way to begin again.
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GX363HMX

About Taro Iwamoto

I help self-aware adults who feel stuck in recurring pain, tension, bracing, or fear of movement — even after trying many approaches — discover a gentler somatic, nervous-system-based path toward more ease, trust, and freedom in their body.

My work is not about forcing the body to change, finding the perfect exercise, or diagnosing what is wrong.

It is about helping your body and nervous system experience support, safety, connection, and new possibilities through gentle somatic movement.

videos.title: Zach Benson & What Is Pressure | Morning Cuppa Hockey
videos.summary_source_text:
Zach Benson & What Is Pressure | Morning Cuppa Hockey Buffalo Sabres forward Zach Benson joins Jonny Lazarus and Colby Cohen on Morning Cuppa Hockey following the signing of his massive seven-year, $7.5 million AAV contract extension.

Benson discusses his summer training in Vancouver, making the jump directly to the NHL as an 18-year-old, finding another level offensively and experiencing playoff hockey for the first time. He takes us inside Buffalo’s unforgettable postseason run, including the atmosphere surrounding Game 1, the passionate Sabres fan base, the Blade Gang, playing in Boston and Montreal, preparing for Game 7 and scoring the game-winning goal on his 21st birthday at the Bell Centre.

Before the interview, Jonny and Colby break down Benson’s contract, Buffalo’s collection of team-friendly deals, the possibility of Connor Hellebuyck becoming the Sabres’ missing piece and why Patrick Kane returning home to Buffalo would have been such a great story.

After the conversation with Benson, the guys discuss the Shoulder Check hockey event, its message of supporting teammates and checking in on the people around you, the responsibility star players have to influence an entire dressing room and the importance of positive self-talk. Jonny and Colby also debate the pressure NHL players face in markets such as New York and Toronto, where that pressure really comes from, the relationship between players and the media and why confrontational questions rarely produce meaningful answers.

More than 50% of adults in the United States have high blood pressure, and many don’t know it. High blood pressure is often called the “silent killer” because it can go undetected.

Research has shown that the wall sit is one of the best exercises to help reduce systolic blood pressure. A wall sit is an isometric exercise, meaning your muscles contract without movement.

The wall sit exercise can lower systolic blood pressure by about 8 points, outperforming many other forms of exercise. If you have high diastolic blood pressure, cardio exercise may be more beneficial.

Reducing high blood pressure may also lower your risk of:
• Cardiovascular events
• Coronary heart disease
• Stroke
• Heart failure
• All-cause mortality

To help support healthy blood pressure levels, perform 4 wall sits in a row, holding each for 2 minutes with a 2-minute rest between each set. Repeat this routine 3 times per week.

videos.summary_source_text:
New Porsche Cayenne Turbo: This Shouldn't Be Legal The new Porsche Cayenne Electric could make petrol-powered cars extinct! 

Get 20% off Car Vertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

Mat’s got his hands on the all-new Porsche Cayenne Turbo Electric, and he’s about to see if the most powerful Porsche ever is truly deserving of so much power. 

For starters, let’s check out the design… 

From the front, it’s fair to say that the exterior design is an improvement over the old petrol-powered Cayenne! It has a real presence from the front, with aggressive air scoops on either side, while the Turbo edition has additional vents and air intakes across the bumper. Along the side, there are wider surrounds on the wheel arches, and the Turbo edition we’re reviewing has a grey satin effect on the roof bars and window surrounds. There are also blackened side skirts, which, in this case, have "Turbo" written on them. Along the back there’s an aggressive diffuser, and the Porsche badge is embossed into the full-length light bar. 

On the inside, this new Cayenne has moved away from traditional Porsche interior designs of old, with the incorporation of more screens. There are dual screens in the centre console, a passenger screen, and a large, curved digital dial display. The dial display comes with lots of customisable options, and a lot of the functionality for the car is managed through the infotainment screen. Thankfully, though, there are physical buttons for the climate control. The seats are firm and figure-hugging, and there are soft-touch materials throughout most of the cabin - although you don’t have to search too hard to find some scratchy plastics! 

The Cayenne Turbo Electric is powered by two electric motors, and these combine to produce an incredible 1,156hp and 1,500Nm! It may be heavy, tipping the scales at 2,645kg, but it still launches like a rocket ship! It’s equipped with a 113kWh battery pack, and it has a claimed range of 350 - 387 miles. 

The Cayenne Electric range starts from £83,265 (as of August 2026), rising all the way up to £130,965 for the Turbo. But of course, it doesn’t stop there - the car we’re reviewing, with options, costs over £172,000! So is it worth it? And would you choose an electric Cayenne over an older, petrol-powered alternative? Let us know in the comments!

videos.summary_source_text:
Why the Texas Rangers Stayed Quiet at the MLB Trade Deadline | DLLS Rangers Podcast Become a DIEHARD! alldlls.com/diehard

The buzz did not match trade-deadline reality Monday with the Texas Rangers are the MLB trade deadline. They did next to nothing, trading away Josh Smith to Toronto for Adam Macko, a young left-handed pitcher. videos.summary_source_text:
04.08.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

• AI-Powered Trading Tools

videos.summary_source_text:
Remembering When Avs Favorites Played For Other Teams and Shjon Podein's Marathon Cup Celebration Colorado Avalanche fans reflect on the heartbreak of key player departures—does losing your favorites ever get easier? Chris Micieli and Zach Pearson share personal stories about saying goodbye to Tyson Barrie, Matt Duchene, and iconic names like Chris Drury and Peter Forsberg, exploring how trades and free agency shape the emotional landscape of hockey fandom. Which Avs loss still stings the most, and how do fans cope when beloved jerseys no longer match the roster?

Listeners weigh in with their own toughest goodbyes, while the hosts debate infamous Avalanche trades and the quirks of jersey loyalty. The episode rounds out with a fun look at unusual NHL records—from Sjhon Podien’s 25-hour gear marathon to Tie Domi’s fighting legacy—and asks whether anyone can break the iron-man games played record with today’s 84-game schedule. Rediscover what it means to be a diehard Avs supporter, on and off the ice.

videos.summary_source_text:
Activate This Muscle To Avoid Slipping The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

Why Does McDavid Strides Wide? The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

If you want to get 6 pack abs, there are a few things you need to get right. In this video, I’m breaking down 13 of my best tips for getting six pack abs by combining smarter nutrition, better ab workouts, and more effective exercise technique. You cannot build a visible, ripped six pack by focusing on ab exercises alone. You need to train the muscles correctly while also lowering body fat through a sustainable nutrition plan.

The first tip starts where your day begins. After going several hours without water while you sleep, you may wake up mildly dehydrated. Drinking 16 to 20 ounces of water shortly after waking can help you rehydrate before training, eating, or starting the rest of your day. Proper hydration supports exercise performance, energy, and the quality of your ab workouts. Whether your goal is to lose belly fat or perform better in the gym, staying hydrated matters.

Next, pay attention to the order of your ab exercises. Start with lower ab exercises that require you to move the legs or pelvis. These movements are often more demanding and require greater control. Save top-down movements, such as crunch variations, for later in the workout. This lets you perform the hardest exercises while your abs are fresh and your form is still strong.

When it comes to nutrition for six pack abs, use a simple plate strategy to control portions without counting every calorie. Imagine your plate as a clock. Fill the largest portion with fibrous carbohydrates such as vegetables. Fill the next largest portion with a quality source of protein. Use the smallest section for starchy carbohydrates, then include a modest amount of dietary fat. This makes it easier to build balanced meals and stay consistent with your fat loss goals.

For a complete list of better carbohydrate choices, visit https://athleanx.com/carbs.

During your ab workouts, stop focusing only on how many reps you complete. Make every repetition count. A fast, careless rep that creates little tension in the abs should not count the same as a controlled contraction. Slow the movement down and focus on feeling the abdominal muscles do the work. Quality contractions will do more for building defined abs than racing through sloppy repetitions.

On lower ab exercises, think about lifting the pelvis rather than simply lifting the legs. Moving the legs without curling the pelvis can allow the hip flexors to take over. When possible, squeeze the knees together to engage the adductors. This can improve pelvic stability and create a stronger contraction in the lower abs.

For upper ab exercises, imagine a line running across the bottom of your ribcage. Try to fold your torso over that line. Focus on lifting the shoulder blades off the floor by contracting the abs instead of pulling on your head or neck. This can make top-down ab exercises safer and more effective.

Your diet can also include a few simple additions that may support fat loss when used consistently. Green tea, cinnamon, and red pepper flakes are easy additions. I personally use Ceylon cinnamon in oatmeal and red pepper flakes in different foods throughout the day. None of these will give you abs by themselves, but small habits can support a stronger nutrition plan when combined with training, calorie control, and consistency.

Breathing is another important part of ab training. If you push your abdomen outward every time you exhale, you may reinforce a distended appearance through the midsection. Instead, tighten the waist by engaging the transverse abdominis as you breathe out. Think about drawing the abdomen inward while maintaining control of the movement. With practice, this can become automatic and improve your control of the core.

The rest of the 13 tips for getting 6 pack abs are covered in the video. Watch the full breakdown and let me know which tip helped you most.

Getting abs is not about finding one magical exercise or following an extreme diet. It comes from combining effective ab workouts, better technique, proper hydration, smart food choices, portion control, and a plan you can follow long enough to see results. The goal is not simply to lose weight. It is to reduce body fat while building strong, visible abdominal muscles.

videos.summary_source_text:
Don’t Touch This After Washing Your Hands—It Could Make You Sick | Dr. Mandell You may wash your hands correctly and still put germs right back onto them within seconds. Faucet handles, restroom doors, damp towels, cell phones, shopping carts, gas pumps, menus, and self-checkout screens are touched repeatedly throughout the day. In this video, Dr. Alan Mandell explains how clean hands can become recontaminated, why touching your eyes, nose, or mouth matters, and the simple public-restroom habit that can reduce unnecessary exposure. Proper handwashing means using soap, scrubbing every surface for at least 20 seconds, cleaning around the thumbs, fingertips, fingernails, and between the fingers, then drying completely. This is not about fearing every germ—it is about protecting your hands after they are clean, especially before eating, during cold and flu season, while traveling, and whenever someone around you is sick. Share this important reminder with your family and friends.

Det här är en bjässe på över 5,2 meter med tre stolsrader (2+2+2-layout). Med dubbelkammarluftfjädring, bakhjulsstyrning med en EREV-drivlina (räckviddsförlängare) som ger en totalkapacitet på över 1 600 km och ren elräckvidd upp till 406 km CLTC. Mjukvaran och förarstödet (drivet av Momenta R7) ligger på en helt annan nivå än vad vi är vana vid från VW i Europa.
Priset i Kina startar på 309 800 yuan vilket ungefär är det samma som man tidigare sålt VW ID4- för i Kina!

Den är utvecklad snabbt och billigt i Kina och kommer kanske att tillverkas i Europa, och varför inte i USA! Då har VW ett fantastiskt vapne mot de Kineiska tillverkarna som har svårt att få tillträde till den amerikanske marknaden. En Game Changer??

videos.title: Hips in the downswing
videos.summary_source_text:
Hips in the downswing Have you ever felt like your downswing is out of sync, as if your arms are on their own mission apart from your body? It's a common issue, swinging steeply can cause a whole array of problems, from hitting the ball off to the right, hooking, chunking, and feeling disconnected. The right elbow’s position plays a pivotal role in managing these downswing issues. Simply put, if your right elbow is out of alignment, syncing up your swing becomes nearly impossible.

First Move of the Downswing: Tucking the Elbow

When initiating your downswing, the key is to ensure your right elbow tucks into your right side. This initial move helps you shallow the club and aligns it perfectly, with the club pointing at the golf ball or just outside of it when you're halfway through your downswing. It's a position that empowers you to direct your full energy efficiently into the ball, reducing reliance on timing. 

Should your elbow pop out early instead, you create a steep club path, leading to inconsistent hits and potential wrist strain. Remember, a rogue elbow often results in losing the angle of lag and, consequently, makes solid contact elusive.

Creating Daylight with the Daylight Elbow Tuck

If you tuck the elbow correctly, you’ll notice a slight gap between your left arm and right elbow. This 'daylight' indicates you’re creating enough space to release the club naturally. In turn, this space allows your body to prepare for a powerful release at the point just ahead of the ball.

Rope Pull Analogy: The Ideal Body Mechanics

Picture holding a heavy weight attached to a rope or imagine pulling a car with a rope. You wouldn't merely push it forward; instead, you’d situate your body to pull effectively. Engage your right elbow by feeling like your funny bone is sticking to your right shirt seam. As your body opens up during the swing, this feeling helps create a dynamic and powerful position.

Maintaining body rotation is critical. Many players make the mistake of stopping their body’s rotation to get their arms ahead: a posture that complicates the swing. Keep the rotation flowing, allowing your hips and chest to guide the club toward impact.

Executing the Perfect Downswing

Reflect on these fundamentals: tuck your elbow early, feel the connection of that funny bone against your body, and keep rotating. Employing these techniques provides a sense of power and control. Much like pulling that rope, transferring this mental image to your golf swing unlocks swing potential. Now, go hit those awe-inspiring shots with confidence!

The right elbow’s position plays a pivotal role in managing these downswing issues. Simply put, if your right elbow is out of alignment, syncing up your swing becomes nearly impossible.

When initiating your downswing, the key is to ensure your right elbow tucks into your right side. This initial move helps you shallow the club and aligns it perfectly, with the club pointing at the golf ball or just outside of it when you're halfway through your downswing. It's a position that empowers you to direct your full energy efficiently into the ball, reducing reliance on timing. 

Should your elbow pop out early instead, you create a steep club path, leading to inconsistent hits and potential wrist strain. Remember, a rogue elbow often results in losing the angle of lag and, consequently, makes solid contact elusive.

If you tuck the elbow correctly, you’ll notice a slight gap between your left arm and right elbow. This 'daylight' indicates you’re creating enough space to release the club naturally. In turn, this space allows your body to prepare for a powerful release at the point just ahead of the ball.

03.08.26 - RIFT Education Day RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

videos.title: Nyss fyllt 18: vad borde jag veta om pengar? (2026)
videos.summary_source_text:
Nyss fyllt 18: vad borde jag veta om pengar? (2026) En artonåring messade mig med en enkel fråga: "Vad borde jag veta om pengar och långsiktigt sparande?" I den här videon svarar jag och Oliver med fem konkreta råd.

Det viktigaste är att börja spara så tidigt som möjligt, ränta-på-ränta-effekten är svår att greppa men gör en enorm skillnad över tid. Vi går igenom den så kallade tolv-tolv-tolv-principen: sparar du en summa i tolv år kan du sedan ta ut samma summa varje månad resten av livet.

Vi pratar också om varför en dyr bil som artonåring ofta är ett av de sämsta ekonomiska besluten man kan ta, varför det lönar sig att öka inkomsten tidigt, och varför breda, billiga globala indexfonder (eller en fondrobot som Lysa eller Opti) slår att försöka pricka rätt aktier själv.

Oliver har suttit i styrelsen för Unga Aktiesparare i fem år och berättar varför gemenskapen där är värdefull för unga som vill ta tag i sin ekonomi tidigt.

Fler guider på rikatillsammans.se.

⚠️ Viktig info:

Detta innehåll är inte individuell investeringsrådgivning. Ett sparande i linje med forskningens rekommendationer har historiskt sett varit framgångsrikt. Det finns mycket som talar för att så även kommer vara framgent, men det finns inga garantier. Historisk avkastning är ingen garanti för framtida avkastning. Alla investeringar innebär risk och kan både öka och minska i värde. Investera inte pengar du inte har råd att förlora. Mer info på rikatillsammans.se.

Författat av Jan Bolmeson per publicerat datum. Vi äger andelar i nämnda fonder genom regelbundet månadssparande. Vi är fristående från nämnda bolag och värdepapper; ingen ersättning har utgått om ej annat anges ovan. Tidigare omnämningar finns som etikett på rikatillsammans.se. Vi avser inte följa upp detta innehåll.

videos.title: The golf warm up every player needs
videos.summary_source_text:
The golf warm up every player needs Stop wasting your first 20 range balls. 

Here’s how to warm up with purpose instead 👇 

Your pre round warm up should prepare the movement you want to take onto the course! Try this club progression with a blue brick 

⛳ 58° wedge
⛳ 50° wedge
⛳ 8 iron
⛳ 5 iron
⛳ Driver

Start with controlled swings, focus on shallowing the club, and gradually build up to your longer clubs. The goal isn’t to “find” your swing by hitting more balls. It’s to reinforce the right movement before you reach the first tee. 

Save this routine for your next range session and if you want help learning how to shallow the club, check out the blue Brick:  https://sbrew.link/7r6JjJpL

videos.title: Refrigerate These Carbs Overnight to Heal Your Gut, Balance Blood Sugar, & Lose Weight | Dr Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
Refrigerate These Carbs Overnight to Heal Your Gut, Balance Blood Sugar, & Lose Weight | Dr Mandell Most people believe rice, potatoes, pasta, oats, and bread affect the body exactly the same way every time they eat them, but cooking and refrigerating these carbohydrates can change part of their starch through a process called retrogradation. As the food cools for several hours or overnight, some of the starch becomes resistant starch, making it harder for digestive enzymes to break down rapidly into glucose. Instead, part of it travels into the colon, where beneficial bacteria ferment it and produce butyrate, an important short-chain fatty acid that nourishes the cells lining the colon, supports the intestinal barrier, and helps regulate immune and inflammatory activity. This process may also produce a steadier blood-sugar response, improve satisfaction after eating, reduce the usable calories absorbed from the resistant portion, and support weight control when combined with sensible portions and a healthy lifestyle. In this video, you will learn which carbohydrates can be cooked and refrigerated, how long to cool them, whether reheating destroys the resistant starch, how to store rice safely, and how to combine these foods with protein, vegetables, healthy fats, and vinegar or lemon for an even healthier metabolic response. Refrigeration does not eliminate all the carbohydrates or calories, but it can change how part of that starch behaves inside your digestive system. Sometimes improving your health is not only about what you eat—it is also about how you prepare, refrigerate, and reheat it.

videos.title: After Injury: How Soon to Exercise Again?
videos.summary_source_text:
After Injury: How Soon to Exercise Again? The answer is: not today, but also not too long.

For most minor injuries, you want to get back to movement once the initial inflammation settles and you have a better idea of what you're dealing with.

As a general rule, if discomfort is around 4/10 or less, careful movement is often appropriate:

Walking
Gentle strengthening
Controlled stretching

Movement during recovery can help restore function and provide the mechanical loading that supports collagen remodeling and better tissue organization as you heal. 💪

The goal isn't to push through pain. It's to get moving again without waiting until you feel 100%. The answer is: not today, but also not too long.

Filmed ahead of the 2026 Genesis Scottish Open, just one week before The Open Championship, Min Woo reflects on his journey from growing up in a golfing family in Australia to becoming a winner on the global stage.

He discusses how watching Tiger Woods inspired his passion for the game, the influence of Australian great Adam Scott, and the role his family played in shaping his career. videos.summary_source_text:
This is the best car America has ever made! Hennessey has released an all-new Koenigsegg competitor - the Blackbird!

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-0308

The Blackbird follows on from Hennessey’s first two hypercars, the Venom GT & Venom F5, and it’s been inspired by the legendary SR-71 Blackbird aircraft. 

The question is, what makes it a true Koenigsegg competitor? Let’s take a closer look… Starting with the engine! 

While the Venom GT & F5 were both powered by the same twin-turbo V8, Hennessey instead opted to fit the Blackbird with an all-new, 6.2-litre naturally-aspirated V8. This produces between 800 and 850hp, with all of this power sent to the rear wheels only via a 6-speed manual! 

What’s more, it revs to 9000RPM (the highest-revving naturally-aspirated V8 on any road car), can hit 60mph in 2.5 seconds (about the same as the CC850), and it has a top speed of 220mph!

When it comes to the design, the Blackbird is largely just made from carbon fibre, which means it only weighs in at 1,360kg. The sculpted doors mirror the shape of the SR-71, as does the sky glass roof, along with the rear stabilisers, which automatically deploy once you hit 71 mph. Speaking of the rear end, the Blackbird also comes with diamond-shaped, quad tailpipes, and the diamond shape is mirrored in the headlights as well. All-in, this long and low hypercar looks absolutely incredible! 

Step inside, and it feels like you’ve stepped back in time - there are no screens anywhere! The Blackbird comes with analogue dials and a built-in mount for your phone. It also has an old-fashioned key, as well as twin carbon fibre seats, and 4(!) cupholders. The swooping-style design reminds us of the Bugatti Tourbillon, and the overhead switches once again hark back to the SR-71. 

But of course, it doesn’t come cheap - the Blackbird costs from $2,500,000, and it’ll be limited to just 71 units. The question is, would you choose it over a Koenigsegg CC850? Let us know in the comments! Hennessey has released an all-new Koenigsegg competitor - the Blackbird!

videos.summary_source_text:
Can’t Find the Center of the Clubface? Try This Drill 👀⛳️ Can’t find the center of the clubface? This drill will show you exactly why. 

Most golfers try to fix inconsistent contact by changing their swing. But first, you need to understand where the ball is actually meeting the clubface!

This drill helps you:
→ Identify heel and toe strikes
→ Build awareness of the clubface
→ Practice intentionally moving contact
→ Work your way back to the center 

Start by intentionally striking one from the toe, then one from the heel. Once you can control both, finding the middle becomes much easier.

It’s not about making golf more complicated. It’s about giving your practice immediate feedback.

Save this drill for your next range session and comment “BRICK” if you want to try the Blue Brick for yourself.

Colorado Avalanche’s contract puzzle heats up as Artturi Lehkonen’s extension talks are overshadowed by the impending Cale Makar mega-deal. Is the Avalanche front office undervaluing Lehkonen’s top-line impact, or will age and cap space dictate a short-term offer? Chris Micieli and Zach Pearson debate the right term and dollar figure for Lehkonen and dissect his underappreciated contributions compared to stars like Nathan MacKinnon and Martin Necas.

The conversation shifts to Avalanche roster strategy, exploring the team’s aging core and the potential infusion of youth with prospects like Brindley, LaRue, and Svechkov. Plus: fan mailbag highlights favorite NHL arenas, must-see games including the Winter Classic, and top picks for movies and books. videos.title: Michael Thorbjornsen gets FIRST TOUR WIN with 7-under 63! | Round 4 | Rocket Classic | 2026
videos.summary_source_text:
Michael Thorbjornsen gets FIRST TOUR WIN with 7-under 63! | Round 4 | Rocket Classic | 2026 In the final round of the 2026 Rocket Classic, Michael Thorbjornsen shoots a bogey-free 7-under 63 to claim his first PGA TOUR victory.

The PGA TOUR heads to Detroit this week for the Rocket Classic, the penultimate event of the 2026 Regular Season, with FedExCup Playoff places still up for grabs. Detroit Golf Club also unveils its extensive $16 million renovation for the first time, providing a fresh challenge as players make one final push before the postseason. Fresh off his breakthrough victory at the 3M Open, 21-year-old Jackson Koivun returns looking to build on his rapid rise after climbing into the FedExCup's top 70. World No. 3 Cameron Young leads the field alongside recent three-time winner Chris Gotterup, while Wyndham Clark arrives in excellent form following an impressive summer that included his second U.S. Open title. Defending champion Aldrich Potgieter also returns, aiming to become the first player to successfully defend the Rocket Classic. The field is further strengthened by Russell Henley, Xander Schauffele, J.J. Spaun, Si Woo Kim and Akshay Bhatia, while Jordan Spieth and Brooks Koepka are both set to make their tournament debuts. With just one week remaining before the FedExCup Playoffs begin, every point carries added significance for those looking to extend their seasons. With 500 FedExCup points on offer and the Playoff race reaching its climax, the Rocket Classic promises another pivotal week as the PGA TOUR Regular Season enters its final stretch.

videos.summary_source_text:
Before You Step Out of the Shower, Do This for Just 10 Seconds | Dr. Mandell Have you ever felt dizzy, lightheaded, or unsteady after stepping out of a hot shower? In this video, Dr. Alan Mandell explains the fascinating physiology behind why it happens and shares a simple 10- to 20-second habit that may help your body transition more comfortably. Learn how hot water affects your blood vessels, circulation, blood pressure, and nervous system, why dehydration and certain medications can make symptoms worse, and why a comfortably cool rinse before leaving the shower may help you feel steadier, more alert, and refreshed. You'll also discover practical tips to improve shower safety, reduce your risk of falls, and better understand how your body responds to changes in temperature. These simple daily habits can make a meaningful difference in how you feel and help you start or end your day with greater confidence.

videos.title: The "Inner Spring" That Makes McDavid's Stride Effortless
videos.summary_source_text:
The "Inner Spring" That Makes McDavid's Stride Effortless How McDavid Gets Free Speed From His Muscles

There is a kind of speed that costs you almost nothing to produce, and most players never tap into it because they try to generate everything with raw muscle instead. The clue shows up in a simple test. Take the exact same athlete and have them jump one way that removes the little dip beforehand, then jump again using a quick countermovement first, and the second jump is meaningfully higher despite the identical effort, typically by somewhere in the range of five to fifteen percent. Nothing about their strength changed. What changed is that the dip let their tendons load up like a spring and hand that energy back, and those same elastic tissues are what quietly lower the cost of every stride when you use them well.

Jason breaks down where this "inner spring" actually lives in your body, why the same mechanism you see in a golfer's backswing shows up in your forward stride, and how learning to load it turns your skating from something you grind out into something that blends effortlessly into your cross-unders, shuffles, and the ten-and-two movements you see McDavid flow through constantly. Watch the full breakdown to see how to find your inner spring and stop leaving free speed on the ice.

videos.summary_source_text:
Jason Castriota designade Saabarna som aldrig tillverkades. Exklusiv intervju! I den här exklusiva intervjun avslöjar Jason Castriota den okända historien om sin tid på Saab. Från varför han började och dynamiken med Victor Muller, till sin passion för märket – och hela historien bakom de legendariska bilarna som aldrig nådde produktion.

Han öppnar också dörren för möjligheten att någon faktiskt skulle kunna bygga Sonett i dag…

Se till att prenumerera så du inte missar något!

Bakgrund:
Efterföljaren till den sista generationen Saab 9-3 hade kommit mycket långt, när Saab gick i konkurs. Projekt 540, eller Phoenix/Fenix,  hade bland annat en ny avancerad bak- och framvagn, ny drivlina och även en elbakaxel på gång.
Anders Johansson och Gabriel Palmenäs (som givetvis jobbade på Saab när det begav sig) driver företaget Griffin Cars, och har köpt upp ett restlager av axlar och motorer för att modernisera befintliga Saab 9-3 bilar.
Men den stora planen är att bygga en liten serie moderna bilar, med äkta Saabteknik! (Det återkommer vi till längre fram)
I en serie intervjuer med Saab-folk som var med och utvecklade Fenixplattformen, ska vi tala teknik, men givetvis också provköra en av de uppdaterade bilarna.

videos.summary_source_text:
Most Coaches Make This Power Skating Mistake The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

Welcome to H.I.T Golf Reviews – the home of honest, independent and trustworthy golf equipment reviews.

If you want straight-talking advice on drivers, irons, wedges, putters, golf balls and golf tech, you’re in the right place. Every review is based on proper testing, launch monitor data and real on-course experience – not marketing slides.

buying your first proper set,

videos.title: Is Longevity a Lie?
videos.summary_source_text:
Is Longevity a Lie? Is longevity a big lie?

The idea is simple: eat well, exercise, manage your stress, have good relationships... and you'll live to 100.

The problem is, that's not what the data show.

The New England Centenarian Study, one of the best studies we have on people who actually make it to 100, found that exceptional longevity is largely genetic. You really do need to win the genetic lottery.

What's even weirder is that plenty of centenarians smoked, drank, never exercised, and lived pretty normal lives. They don't avoid heart disease, cancer, or dementia. They just tend to get them later than everyone else. Their genes seem to buy them another decade.

That's why I think the longevity movement is a little misleading.

What we're really talking about is healthspan.

Exercise, good nutrition, sleep, and stress management probably won't turn you into a centenarian. But they can absolutely help you stay stronger, healthier, and more independent for the years you do have. Is longevity a big lie?

Grok vs GPT — Who’s Actually Winning the Race to AGI? Link to our newsletter: https://bitbiased.ai/
Claude Opus 5 just took the #1 spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index — but does that actually mean Anthropic is now ahead of OpenAI, Google and xAI in the race toward AGI?

In this video, we break down the latest AI leaderboard using independent benchmark data from Artificial Analysis and compare Claude Opus 5, OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol, xAI Grok 4.5 and Google Gemini across intelligence, agentic performance, ARC-AGI benchmarks, pricing and real-world value.

The surprising conclusion: there may no longer be one AI race.

Anthropic currently has one of the strongest overall benchmark claims with Claude Opus 5. OpenAI still dominates important areas with GPT-5.6 Sol. Grok 4.5 makes an increasingly interesting price-to-performance argument. And Google Gemini finds itself in an unusual position on this particular scorecard.

videos.title: Your hips might NOT be the reason your hips won’t clear
videos.summary_source_text:
Your hips might NOT be the reason your hips won’t clear Your hips might NOT be the reason your hips won’t clear. 👀⛳️
If your trail shoulder moves out and over during the downswing, your upper body takes over—causing your hips to stall and your club to swing across your body.
Instead, focus on keeping your trail shoulder back and working underneath the swing plane. This allows your lead hip to clear naturally, helps the club approach from the inside, and lets you release more lower-body power through impact.

The goal:
✅ A shallower downswing
✅ Better hip rotation
✅ An inside club path
✅ More power and accuracy
✅ More consistent ball striking

Pay attention to your shoulder plane—the problem may not be your lower body after all.

Why Are My Crossunders Better On One Side? The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

videos.summary_source_text:
Whenever I Struggle To Hit Driver Straight, I Remember To Do This Are you struggling to hit your driver straight — even though every so often you produce one perfect shot down the middle?

In this golf lesson video, Danny Maude shows you the simple relationship that controls whether your golf ball flies straight, slices right or hooks left…and how you can begin changing it before you even start your swing.

Most golfers try to hit driver straight by changing lots of moving parts. But the curve of the golf ball is largely created by the relationship between your clubface and swing path.

Once you understand that relationship, your ball flight becomes far less mysterious.

In this video, you’ll discover:

✅ Why your driver slices even when the clubface appears to be pointing straight
✅ The simple “football kick” image that makes face-to-path easier to understand
✅ How to build a better clubface and swing-path relationship into your setup
✅ A small forearm and elbow adjustment that can help turn a slice into a draw
✅ What to change if you struggle with a hook
✅ Why a good setup can still disappear during the backswing
✅ How to identify the exact moment your clubface begins to open
✅ A simple way to practise the feeling without becoming overly technical

This lesson worked incredibly well for several of my students this week because it gave them something they could understand, feel and take directly onto the golf course.

The goal isn’t to manufacture a perfect golf swing.

It’s to develop a clearer awareness of where the clubface is pointing in relation to the direction the club is travelling.

Once those two begin working together, hitting your driver straighter becomes much easier.

videos.title: Slice to Draw in ONE Lesson #golfswing #golftips
videos.summary_source_text:
Slice to Draw in ONE Lesson #golfswing #golftips John’s club was going under the plane in the backswing and over the top on the way down — leading to pulls and slices. While his path stayed consistent, his clubface wasn’t. The best fix? Learning to create a draw shape. We set up a simple alignment stick station: one along the target line, one behind him on the swing plane, and one through the target. His goal was to take it back over the plane and come under through impact.
This visual drill completely changed John’s clubface control — and helped him start hitting solid draws.

Hitting weak golf shots out to the right? ⛳ Hitting weak golf shots out to the right? Your trail knee could be the real problem.

Too much right-knee flex can make your hips sway instead of rotate. Straighten your trail leg too much, and you may fall into a reverse pivot. The key is finding the athletic middle ground:
✅ Rotate your hips 40–45°
✅ Keep the right amount of trail-knee flex
✅ Load pressure into your trail side
✅ Get ready to shift forward with power

videos.title: En bra känsla för alla slag. Alltid från bakre höft till främre axel…
videos.channel: Bättre & Enklare golf med Marcus Edblad PGA
videos.summary_source_text:
En bra känsla för alla slag. Alltid från bakre höft till främre axel… Att svinga från bakre höft till främre axel ger oss väldigt många fördelar och en otroligt skön känsla i slagen.

Vi behöver rotera för att hjälpa våra händer förflytta sig men allt annan rotation är bortkastad energi.

#golf #golftips #golfswing 

0:00 Intro till så här ska det kännas

Nu finns det möjlighet att genom appen Skillest göra mig till din personliga tränare. Du hittar mig på denna länk: https://skillest.com/app/profile/marcus-edblad

Låt mig hjälpa dig finna bättre slag, bollträff, riktning och svinghastighet. Oavsett om du slår en wedge, järnklubba eller driver kan du med dina händer lära dig golfslag som du inte trodde var möjliga. Längre och rakare slag kräver alltid träning men något alla kan lära sig.  

Vare sig du kämpar med en slice eller en hook så har jag videos som kan guida till bättre golf. Är du nybörjare så kan du börja med min grönt kort eller nybörjarkurs.

Försök ersätta dåliga vanor med nya bättre vanor. Oavsett vilket loft eller skaft din klubba har så är det du som bestämmer vad som ska hända. Oavsett om det står callaway, ping, titleist eller taylor made på klubban så kan du slå bra slag.

Var noga med vad du tittar på. Det finns många duktiga instruktörer på nätet, några av mina favoriter är Mike Malaska, Mike Dunaway, Mike Austin.

Försök fokusera på grunderna i slaget bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår. Träna med fördel på en sak i taget. Tränar du din svinghastighet måste du tillåta att det går snett och tränar du raka slag kan du inte samtidigt svinga i max fart.

Ha tålamod och låt det ta sin tid, luras inte av genvägar som bara gör att du tappar fokus från det viktiga. Golf kommer alltid vara svårt men vi kan med träning se till att vi blir bättre för varje dag som går.

Titta mycket på golf på TV. Bryson Dechambeu, Dustin Johnson, Rory Mcilroy kan inspirera till längre slag och andra som Tiger Woods, Viktor Hovland, Ludvig Åberg och Phil Mickelson kan ge dig fantasi att skapa nya slag.

Träna styrketräning för hela kroppen för att må bra genom livet och skapa en effektiv maskin. Träna händer, handleder och armar för att skapa en effektiv release och mer svinghastighet.

Du kan finna inspiration i filmer som Happy Gilmore, Tin Cup eller Bagger Vance. Filmer som Rocky kan ge dig motivation att ta dig till gymet. Legender som Arnold Schwarzenegger, Sylvester Stallone eller Hulk Hogan kan få dig att vilja bli starkare och Moe Norman, Arnold Palmer, Ben Hogan, Sam Snead eller Jack Nicklaus kan inspirera dig att bli en bättre golfare. 

Ge aldrig upp i sökandet och träningen för att få bästa bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår.

Filmat med iPhone 17 och redigerat i iMovie på en Macbook. Att svinga från bakre höft till främre axel ger oss väldigt många fördelar och en otroligt skön känsla i slagen.

Vi behöver rotera för att hjälpa våra händer förflytta sig men allt annan rotation är bortkastad energi.

31.07.26 - RIFT Training with Joe RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

It Takes This Kind Of Confidence To Change Your Angle The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

The Curious Case of the Carolina Hurricanes and Jesperi Kotkaniemi As we're now 60 days from Opening Night for the Carolina Hurricanes, what is the plan with the roster? With Seth Jarvis expecting to miss 4 to 6 months, who will replace him in the interim? Could it be Bradly Nadeau, who has shown promise and deserves a longer look? Or is it Jesperi Kotkaniemi, who's been with the team since 2021-22? He's had his chances, but after last season, has it run its course? On the Friday Edition of Locked On Hurricanes,  Zach begins the show by sharing his thoughts on the case of how Kotkaniemi has still not found his role within the Hurricanes' system. He has shown flashes of being someone who can be a defensive center, but doesn't show the physicality enough. Plus, with how he only played 42 games in the regular season and none in the playoffs, has the ship sailed on the Finnish forward? Secondly, Zach shares his thoughts on how Nadeau has proven he could be used more often this upcoming season for the Hurricanes. After scoring three goals in 12 games, along with his play with the Chicago Wolves, how much more does he need to do? Finally, Zach concludes the show by sharing his thoughts on who should start more while Jarvis is out. Is it Kotkaneimi, or Nadeau? Stop blaming your clubface, your right shoulder could be causing BOTH of your worst iron misses. 👀🏌️‍♂️
When your right shoulder moves out toward the ball, it sends your swing path left. From there, you’ll usually see one of two shots:
❌ A solid iron shot that pulls hard left
❌ A weak, floating slice that loses 30–40 yards

The key is learning how to use your right shoulder properly so you can rotate through the ball confidently—without worrying about the dreaded left miss.

One feel for every swing from pith to driver… If I could give you one feeling for every shot this is it. Always swing from trail hip to lead shoulder.

#golfswing #golf #golftips 

Online lesson are now a possibility on Skillest: https://skillest.com/app/profile/marcus-edblad

0:00 Intro to how to feel an effortless golf swing. 

Let me help you get an effortless golfswing with speed, distance and accuracy. I call it the circle of speed. A good release will help you to a better impact and longer drives and irons without slice and hook. How to swing a golf club need to be adjusted to your skill level and experience. 

Long and straight is the goal for everyone but it takes time. Try to focus on one thing not everything when you practise. Impact, face control and swingpath will always be the most important part to drill. We focus too much on rotation but no good golf shot will be executed just by rotating. 

We also need to understand that many myths in golf are misleading. Everything that you find on the internet isn’t true. Ben Hogan, Sam Snead are two of the legends that are often misunderstood.  To understand golf we need to take it step by step and learn every part of the swing before we move on to the next. It's like a big jigsaw puzzle that we all can figure out. 

A will never call a slice sexy but a high draw is beautiful in a very special way. Some pro's that hit draw: Rory McIroy, Xander Schauffele, Patrick Reed, Sepp Straka, Bryson Dechambeau  and many, many more. 

We shall not keep our head still, only start with the hips, look only at the ball or keep the left or right arm straight. Understand what do do with the club and let your body find the best way possible. 

This is not Rick Shiels, Saguto golf, Danny Maude, Meandmygolf, the Average Golfer, Malaska, Mark Crossfield, Alex Elliot Golf or Paige Spiranac. This is a method that anyone can learn if you give it a chance. 

If you use callaway, ping, titleist, takomo or taylor made clubs doesn’t matter you can learn to hit good golf shots. Your loft or your shaft on the club will not change but you can always get better. 

Find what inspires you. Golf basics are the same for everyone. The pga tour, longdrivers or other good golfers can all help you find better golf shots. Watch what they do instead of listed to what they say. Listen mostly to your body and figure out what you need to do to produce the same results as the pros on TV. Be careful when you watch a golf swing in slow motion. The result isn't always what the golfer is trying to do. Feel and real are seldom the same. 

We can find inspiration in a lot of things. You can find training motivation watching movies like Rocky, Tin Cup or Happy Gilmore and find mental inspiration in legends like Arnold Schwarzenegger, Hulk Hogan, Sylvester Stallone or Mike Tyson. Maybe we sometimes need to hear about crazy achievements from people like David Goggins, Jocko Willink, Ct Fletcher, Jim Rohn or Tony Robbins. 

Mike Malaska, Mike Austin, Mike Dunaway, Pete Cowen and Steve Pratt are some of my favorite golf instructors online. Find the tips that make your golf better. Decide what you want to hit. I teach a draw but many like a fade and nobody likes a hook or slice. 

Your hips or your lag is not the key to golf. Your hands will decide the shot and you can do like Tiger Woods and trust your hands. Teach your hands to hit different shots. Hit big hooks and slices to understand what happens. Only straight is not gonna teach you anything. 

Bryson Dechambeu and Kyle Birkshire can inspire you to hit it longer. Tiger Woods and Phil Mickelson can give you inspiration and motivation to test new things and new golf shots. Linn Grant, Viktor Hovland and Ludvig Aberg can show you the future of golf. 

The Masters, Players Championship, The Players, The Open and US Open can make you love golf even more. See the best in the world solve all the problems we all need to master any golf course. Golf is a craft and you need fantasy, feel and skills to master it.

Questions my videos will answer:

How to swing faster. How to hit longer. How to swing faster. How to hit your irons better. How to be better at anything. How to master the circle of speed. How to get a better short game. How to hit your wedge better. How to release the golf club. How to rotate in golf. Best tips for beginner golfers. How to hit down on the ball. How to hit up on the ball. How to rotate hips in the golf swing. How to hit straight every time. How to stop slicing. How to swing effortlessly.

videos.title: Still slicing your driver? Check your right elbow
videos.summary_source_text:
Still slicing your driver? Check your right elbow Still slicing your driver? Check your right elbow 👀

If the tip of your right elbow never gets in front of your shirt seam during the downswing, your hips and shoulders may spin open—sending the club across the ball and straight into “sliced city.” 🏌️‍♂️➡️
Try this instead: let your arms drop, tuck your right elbow just in front of your shirt seam, and allow the club to shallow behind you. This helps you approach the ball from the inside so you can hit straighter drives, create a draw, and find more fairways.

The Blue Brick makes this drill even more effective by giving you instant feedback when you spin out or come over the top.
Ready to fix your slice and build a more consistent driver swing?

videos.summary_source_text:
Strength Training: Best or Worst Trend in 2026? Strength Training: Best or Worst Trend?

Strength training is crucial for aging well. It’s crucial for bone health, metabolic balance, hormones and even brain health. 

But there's a catch.

Many people focus only on strength while neglecting cardio and mobility. That's a mistake. 

Our data also shows that most students over 40 have at least two sedentary days every week (less than 5K steps). 

That’s not good. 

You don't need to become a hybrid athlete or spend hours training every day. You just need a balanced routine that includes three essentials: strength, cardio, and mobility. Strength Training: Best or Worst Trend?

videos.title: Why Pagani BOLTS cost more than a Porsche 911!
videos.summary_source_text:
Why Pagani BOLTS cost more than a Porsche 911! Mat’s flown over to Modena in Italy to visit the Pagani factory. He’ll start off with a visit to the museum, seeing some of the earlier models and Pagani creations. After that, he’ll visit the factory for a personalised tour with Horacio Pagani. 

Explore new and used cars with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-3007

It’s time for an all-access tour of the Pagani factory! 

Mat’s over in Modena, Italy, and he’s about to see just what goes into creating some of the rarest and most expensive cars in the world! 

First up, he’s going to see what led Horacio Pagani to where he is today, with a trip to the Pagani museum. He’ll look over some of his first creations, including a bike and a Formula 2 car, while also getting up close with some of the first Paganis ever created. 

After that, it's time for the factory tour. Mat will join up with Horacio for a look around the factory, but this is no normal car factory! There are no long production lines or a huge workforce. There are only 300 employees in total, and every car is hand-assembled by a small team. Every car has its place in the factory, where it stays during the 9 week build process. This means every element, even down to the tiniest detail, has 100% traceability. 

With only 67 cars made in the last 12 months, it shows just how much detail goes into each car. The question is, what’s your favourite Pagani? Let us know in the comments! 30.07.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

videos.summary_source_text:
Title:3 Easy Ways to Add Driver Distance #golfswing #golftips Here are three straightforward ways to add more distance with your driver. Start by flaring your lead foot and moving the ball farther forward in your stance, which helps you rotate better and hit up on the ball. Next, create a slight tilt away from the target at address to set up the proper launch conditions. Finally, feel more width at the top of the backswing by getting the hands further away from you. These three changes work together to help you hit it longer with more consistency.

videos.title: Three Rare Skating Habits From Connor McDavid
videos.summary_source_text:
Three Rare Skating Habits From Connor McDavid The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

Why Your Shallow Move Isn’t Working #golfswing #golftips Many golfers are trying to shallow the club but doing it the wrong way — by leaning or tilting the upper body back. This move shifts the low point too early, leading to fat and heavy shots.

videos.summary_source_text:
The Most Capable Humanoid Robot Yet! Google just released Gemini Robotics 2 today, and it's a much bigger leap than you may think.

Unlike previous models, it coordinates everything from feet to fingertips, allowing the robot to balance and walk while handling delicate objects.

With 22 degrees of movement in its hands, it can seal Ziploc bags, unscrew lightbulbs, and even tie trash bag knots.

Plus, an on-device version runs locally without an internet connection and can adapt to new robot bodies in just a few hours.

To be clear: this new release "Google Robotics 2" is the AI software behind the robot, not a physical robot you buy directly from Google. It powers hardware from partners like Apptronik on their Apollo 2 robot. 

For Developers: You can access the reasoning model "Gemini Robotics ER 2" today on Google AI Studio.
For Hardware Integrators: The full Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and On-Device models are currently available to partners through Google DeepMind's early access program.

videos.summary_source_text:
Buzz Huddle Test: 4 Humans, 2 AI Agents 🔗 Free Buzz community: https://mrc.fm/cmbuzz
🤖 This video was streamed live on X and edited into highlights by a Buzz AI agent using Fable so apologies for any wonky edits!

🎙️ The audio gets wobbly the moment the huddle starts.

Huddles are a very experimental feature.

My free community on Buzz hit 102 members, so I celebrated by opening a voice huddle and inviting whoever turned up. Four humans and two AI agents later, Grok and Claude Haiku, we had a real answer: it works, it is rough, and the interesting part is not the voice at all. Agents answer in text rather than speech, every reply spins up a full agent harness so the latency is brutal, and the participant list flickers between active and ended while people are clearly still talking. But the live transcript is quietly brilliant, with every line cryptographically signed and attributed to whoever said it, and by the end I had an agent summarise the entire session into something worth sending to the Buzz team. Frequent urination at night is often more than just a bladder or prostate problem. Many people produce one to two cups of urine overnight, and much of this fluid comes from what was consumed earlier in the day, not just before bed.

By age 80, nighttime urination affects most adults. One possible clue is fluid retention, which is often associated with elevated glucose and insulin rather than simply drinking too much water or eating too much salt. An edema test and a fasting insulin test can help identify underlying issues.

Gravity also plays a role. Fluid that accumulates in the legs during the day can return to the bloodstream while you sleep, increasing urine production overnight. Sleep apnea and certain medications can also contribute to frequent nighttime urination.
